fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Snap
fusions.desc: A quick snap that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 25% chance to set it [Burning] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spent Warmth
fusions.desc: Spends 5% of your maximum health to breathe a cone of flame that deals 8 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you and sets each [Burning] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Soak the Heat
fusions.desc: Takes 2 seconds of stillness, then increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Rock Hours
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 10%. You have 10% fire resistance.
